changes.comment: BREAKING: `dreamux onboard` is now provider-ref driven instead of Codex/Feishu specific. The old `--codex-bin`, `--bot-app-id`, and `--bot-app-secret` flags are removed; use `--agent`, `--agent-config-json`, `--channel`, and `--channel-config-json` so core writes provider-owned agent/channel config blocks without reading provider-specific fields. `dreamux doctor`, `dreamux onboard`, and `dreamux daemon install` now ask configured Agent Runtime and Channel providers for their own diagnostics and binary checks instead of hardcoding runtime-only checks in core. Rebuild: rerun `dreamux onboard` to recreate `~/.dreamux/config.json` when upgrading from an old Codex/Feishu-shaped local config.
